lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: You stand before the grand citadel at last. Beyond these gates lies absolute malice.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Who rules over this palace of shadows?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: A charismatic tyrant who pulls the invisible strings of this entire domain.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: His razor threads spare no one. If you hesitate for a split second, you become his puppet.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: No puppet strings can hold me down. I'll tear this whole court apart.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Sever the marionette strings and reclaim the throne. All our hopes rest on you.
